video_title: Steve Nash Explains How He Mastered the Pick & Roll | Anatomy of the Game

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the evolution of the point guard role
quotes.excerpt: I grew up in an era where a point guard wasn't supposed to shoot 25 times
quotes.quote: I grew up in an era where a point guard wasn't supposed to shoot 25 times, 20 times. I tried to be aggressive, but with an open mind to score or playmake when I was at my best.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the importance of creating separation before the screen
quotes.excerpt: If I could loosen my man up before I got to the screen, I just had such
quotes.quote: I didn't want my guy to be attached. If I could loosen my man up before I got to the screen where he was arm's length or more, I just had such a big advantage because now I'm isolated on the big. The big has to commit to me.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on manipulating defenders' body positions
quotes.excerpt: When his hips have turned one way, he can't make a play on a ball behind him
quotes.quote: When his hips have turned one way, he can't make a play on a ball behind him. He tries, but human beings don't have that shoulder mobility. So, when his hips have turned one way, he can't make a play on a ball behind him.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the necessity of developing a left-handed pass
quotes.excerpt: Being able to pass out of my left hand was something that I never said, I got
quotes.quote: Being able to pass out of my left hand was something that I never said, I got to be able to pass out of my left hand. Just playing pickup basketball as a kid, I said, if I can get this to them out of my left right now, that's a wide-open shot.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on using the hang dribble to bait defenders
quotes.excerpt: The hang dribble, hesitation for me was how I played. Essentially my way to articulate is that
quotes.quote: The hang dribble, hesitation for me was how I played. Essentially my way to articulate is that I was just baiting you to get too close. And if you got too close, I was going by you, and if you didn't, I could do it again to bait you again, or I could pull up and shoot.
